title: Group Fitness Class Passes: combining the no-show deduction and loyalty bonus into the final refund figure
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states how the final refund figure for a pack's unused credits is assembled from its two preceding adjustments.

## Basis
The final refund figure paid out is the refund amount reached after the no-show deduction step, plus the corporate wellness loyalty bonus, if any. The two figures are added together — the loyalty bonus is added on top of the after-deduction amount, never subtracted, and never combined by any means other than straightforward addition. Where no loyalty bonus applies, the final figure equals the after-deduction amount unchanged. The final figure, once assembled, is rounded to two decimal places.

## Ordering note
The no-show deduction is applied before the loyalty bonus is considered: the loyalty bonus, where it applies, is calculated on the amount that already reflects the no-show deduction, not on any earlier, undeducted figure. Combining the two steps in the reverse order — adding a bonus calculated on the undeducted amount, and only then subtracting the no-show charge — would reach a different, and incorrect, final figure whenever both adjustments apply to the same refund.

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, the refund amount after the no-show deduction were $40.00, and a loyalty bonus of $2.80 applied on top. The final figure paid out is $40.00 plus $2.80, namely $42.80, rounded to two decimal places.
